camel_example: aliyun polardb EnableSQLRateLimitingRules --region cn-hangzhou --RuleNameList testrule --DBClusterId 'pc-*****************' --Enable true
description_en: Enables or disables SQL throttling rules
kebab_example: aliyun polardb enable-sql-rate-limiting-rules --db-cluster-id 'pc-*****************' --rule-name-list testrule --enable true --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableSQLRateLimitingRules

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Notes on invoking: The SQL throttling feature is supported only for clusters that have the database proxy enabled. Currently, the Oracle-compatible engine is verified to support this feature. For MySQL clusters, confirm whether the database proxy and the SQL throttling feature are enabled
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。调用说明：SQL 限流功能仅支持已开启数据库代理的集群，当前 Oracle 兼容引擎已验证支持；MySQL 集群需先确认是否启用数据库代理和 SQL 限流功能
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of the SQL throttling rules to enable or disable. You can specify multiple rule names for batch operations. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

You can view all SQL throttling rule information, including rule names, on the SQL Firewall tab of the Security Management page in the cluster console
parameters.help_zh:
需要启用的SQL限流规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量查询，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。

您可以在集群的安全管理-SQL防火墙页签中查看所有SQL限流规格信息，包括规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the specified SQL throttling rules. Valid values:

true: enables the rules.
false: disables the rules.

This parameter takes effect only when RuleNameList is specified
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用目标SQL限流规则。取值范围如下：

true：启用。
false：禁用。

仅当RuleNameList有参数值输入时，该参数生效
parameters.name: enable
